verses.text: While Peter and John were speaking to the people, the priests, the temple captain, and the Sadducees came over.
They were upset that the apostles were teaching the people and announcing that Jesus had risen from the dead.
They arrested Peter and John and kept them in custody until the next day, since it was already evening.
But many who heard the message believed. By then, the number of men who believed was about five thousand.
The next morning, the rulers, elders, and legal experts gathered in Jerusalem.
Annas the high priest was there, along with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest’s family.
They brought Peter and John before them and asked, “What power—or whose name—did you use to do this?”
Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “Rulers and elders of the people, listen.
If we’re being questioned today about a good deed done for a disabled man—how he was healed—
then all of you and all the people of Israel should know this: he stands here healed by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, the one you crucified and God raised from the dead.
Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, the stone that became the cornerstone.’
There is salvation in no one else. There is no other name under heaven given to people by which we must be saved!”
The council members saw how boldly Peter and John spoke. They realized these were ordinary, untrained men, and they were stunned. Then they recognized that the two had been with Jesus.
They could say nothing against the healed man standing there with them.
So they ordered Peter and John out of the council chamber and talked it over among themselves.
“What are we going to do with these men?” they asked. “Everyone in Jerusalem knows they performed a remarkable sign, and we can’t deny it.
But we have to stop this from spreading any further. Let’s threaten them so they won’t speak to anyone in this name again.”
They called Peter and John back in and ordered them not to speak or teach in the name of Jesus at all.
But Peter and John answered, “You decide for yourselves: is it right in God’s sight to obey you instead of God?
We can’t keep quiet about what we’ve seen and heard.”
After more threats, they let them go. They couldn’t find a way to punish them because the people were praising God for what had happened.
The man who had been healed in this remarkable way was more than forty years old.
After being released, Peter and John went back to their people and reported everything the chief priests and elders had said.
When the others heard, they raised their voices together to God: “Master, you made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.
Through the mouth of your servant David, you said: ‘Why are the nations in an uproar? Why do the peoples plot what is pointless?
The kings of the earth take their stand, and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against his Anointed One.’
“That is exactly what happened here. Herod and Pontius Pilate joined with the nations and the people of Israel against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.
They did whatever your power and plan had already decided would happen.
Now, Lord, see their threats. Help your servants speak your word with complete boldness.
Stretch out your hand to heal, and let signs and wonders happen through the name of your holy servant Jesus.”
After they prayed, the place where they were gathered shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke God’s word boldly.
All the believers were united in heart and mind. Nobody claimed their possessions as their own; they shared everything.
With great power, the apostles kept telling people that the Lord Jesus had risen from the dead. God’s grace was powerfully at work among them all.
No one among them was in need. People who owned land or houses sold them and brought the money from the sale.
They placed the money at the apostles’ feet, and it was shared out to each person who had a need.
Joses, whom the apostles called Barnabas, was a Levite from Cyprus. The name means “Son of Encouragement.”
He owned a field, sold it, brought the money, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
